req.title: Player payload includes firstName and lastName
req.statement: The system shall include firstName and lastName fields on every player response.
triggers: player payload includes firstname and lastname

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-033 requires that every player response includes firstName and lastName fields. The PlayerResponseModel uses camelCase aliasing (to_camel), so the JSON keys are 'firstName' and 'lastName'. Tests must: (1) verify a known player returns both fields with exact values (positive/EP), (2) verify a non-existent player returns 404 and no player body (negative/NEG), (3) verify the boundary player IDs (first and last seeded rows) both include the fields (BVA). Additional tests check field values are non-null strings and that the exact camelCase key names are present (not snake_case variants), catching key-name mutations and null-return mutations.

tests.name: test_player_response_includes_firstName_and_lastName_known_player
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 seeded player rows
Player with id acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c (Lionel Messi, squad 10) exists
expected: Response JSON contains key 'firstName' with value 'Lionel'
Response JSON contains key 'lastName' with value 'Messi'
trace: R-PLAYER-033: every player response includes firstName and lastName
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_player_response_includes_firstName_and_lastName_known_player():
    r = client.get('/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'firstName' in body
    assert 'lastName' in body
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Lionel'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'
    assert 'first_name' not in body
    assert 'last_name' not in body
